nodes.description: Immutable constant token name string 'Hyperion'.
Immutable constant token symbol 'HYPR'.
Constant decimals value 8 used for display.
Constant total supply 2000000e8 minted to deployer in constructor.
Private constant MAX_UINT256 sentinel meaning unlimited allowance (gas saving shortcut).
Public mapping balanceOf: token balance per address; written in constructor, transfer and transferFrom.
Public nested mapping allowed[owner][spender]: allowance state; written by approve and transferFrom.
SafeMathMod.sub(uint256 a, uint256 b): checked subtraction of uint256 values.
SafeMathMod.add(uint256 a, uint256 b): checked addition of uint256 values.
Hyperion constructor: assigns totalSupply to balanceOf[msg.sender].
transfer(address _to, uint256 _value): moves tokens from msg.sender; requires _to != 0 and isNotContract(_to).
transferFrom(address _from, address _to, uint256 _value): delegated transfer using allowance; special-cases _from == msg.sender and MAX_UINT256.
multiPartyTransfer(address[] _toAddresses, uint256[] _amounts): loops up to 255 times calling transfer.
multiPartyTransferFrom(address _from, address[] _toAddresses, uint256[] _amounts): loops calling transferFrom.
approve(address _spender, uint256 _value): sets allowed[msg.sender][_spender] = _value.
allowance(address _owner, address _spender) view: returns remaining allowance.
isNotContract(address _addr) private view: returns true when extcodesize(_addr) == 0.
Payable fallback function that always reverts on plain ETH transfers.
msg.sender: untrusted external caller; used as balance key, allowance owner/spender key and authorization check.
Raw unchecked subtraction c = a - b inside SafeMathMod.sub with only a require guard.
Raw unchecked addition c = a + b inside SafeMathMod.add with only a require guard.
Inline assembly block using extcodesize(_addr) to probe contract code size.
uint8 loop counter i increment in multiPartyTransfer (i++ can wrap past 255).
uint8 loop counter i increment in multiPartyTransferFrom (i++ can wrap past 255).
Parameter _to of transfer: recipient address.
Parameter _value of transfer: amount of tokens to move.
Parameter _from of transferFrom: owner whose balance is debited.
Parameter _to of transferFrom: recipient address.
Parameter _value of transferFrom: amount of tokens to move.
Parameter _toAddresses array of multiPartyTransfer.
Parameter _amounts array of multiPartyTransfer.
Parameter _from of multiPartyTransferFrom.
Parameter _toAddresses array of multiPartyTransferFrom.
Parameter _amounts array of multiPartyTransferFrom.
Parameter _spender of approve.
Parameter _value of approve: allowance amount granted.
Parameter _owner of allowance view.
Parameter _spender of allowance view.
Parameter _addr of isNotContract: address whose code size is probed.
Parameter a (minuend) of SafeMathMod.sub.
Parameter b (subtrahend) of SafeMathMod.sub.
Parameter a of SafeMathMod.add.
Parameter b of SafeMathMod.add.
Return variable c of SafeMathMod.sub holding a - b.
Return variable c of SafeMathMod.add holding a + b.
Local variable allowance caching allowed[_from][msg.sender] in transferFrom.
Local uint8 loop index i of multiPartyTransfer.
Local uint8 loop index i of multiPartyTransferFrom.
Local variable length receiving extcodesize(_addr) in isNotContract.

edges.reason: msg.sender is used as the balanceOf key when debiting/crediting the caller's balance in constructor, transfer and transferFrom.
msg.sender is used as the owner/spender key into the allowed allowance mapping (approve and transferFrom).
totalSupply constant is assigned into balanceOf[msg.sender] by the constructor.
transfer _value flows into the unchecked subtraction that debits the sender.
transfer _value flows into the unchecked addition that credits the recipient.
transferFrom _value flows into the unchecked subtraction on _from's balance and on the allowance.
transferFrom _value flows into the unchecked addition on _to's balance.
Result of the raw subtraction is written back into balanceOf.
Result of the raw addition is written back into balanceOf.
transfer performs balance arithmetic through SafeMathMod.sub.
transfer performs balance arithmetic through SafeMathMod.add.
transferFrom performs balance/allowance arithmetic through SafeMathMod.sub.
transferFrom performs balance arithmetic through SafeMathMod.add.
allowed[_from][msg.sender] is read out of the allowance mapping into the local allowance variable.
Cached allowance is used by transferFrom's require(_value <= allowance || _from == msg.sender) check.
MAX_UINT256 constant is compared against allowed[_from][msg.sender] to skip allowance reduction.
transferFrom _from is used as the first index (owner key) of the allowed mapping.
approve _value is stored into allowed[msg.sender][_spender].
approve _spender is used as the second index of the allowed mapping.
isNotContract _addr is passed to the inline assembly extcodesize probe.
extcodesize(_addr) result is assigned to the local length variable.
length == 0 determination is returned by isNotContract.
_toAddresses[i] from multiPartyTransfer is passed as the recipient argument of transfer.
_amounts[i] from multiPartyTransfer is passed as the value argument of transfer.
_from of multiPartyTransferFrom is forwarded to transferFrom.
_toAddresses[i] of multiPartyTransferFrom is forwarded to transferFrom.
_amounts[i] of multiPartyTransferFrom is forwarded to transferFrom.
transfer _to is used as the index for the balanceOf credit.
transferFrom _to is used as the index for the balanceOf credit.
transferFrom _from is used as the index for the balanceOf debit.
SafeMathMod.sub parameter a is the minuend of the unchecked subtraction.
SafeMathMod.sub parameter b is the subtrahend of the unchecked subtraction.
Unchecked subtraction result is stored into return variable c of sub.
SafeMathMod.add parameter a is an operand of the unchecked addition.
SafeMathMod.add parameter b is an operand of the unchecked addition.
Unchecked addition result is stored into return variable c of add.
multiPartyTransfer local loop index i is the variable incremented by the uint8 counter operation.
multiPartyTransferFrom local loop index i is the variable incremented by the uint8 counter operation.
transfer requires isNotContract(_to), an internal self-call that gates the transfer.
multiPartyTransfer loops and calls transfer for each recipient.
multiPartyTransferFrom loops and calls transferFrom for each recipient.
multiPartyTransfer's for-loop is driven by the uint8 counter increment operation.
multiPartyTransferFrom's for-loop is driven by the uint8 counter increment operation.
Loop counter i produced by the increment operation indexes the arrays passed to transfer.
Loop counter i produced by the increment operation indexes the arrays passed to transferFrom.
SafeMathMod.sub body executes the raw subtraction operation.
SafeMathMod.add body executes the raw addition operation.
isNotContract enters the inline assembly block that probes the target code size.
transferFrom authorizes the caller through require(_value <= allowance || _from == msg.sender).
approve writes the allowance entry keyed by the untrusted msg.sender.
